scope: Single-inverter-infinite-bus Fig. 8–10 only. Author analytic implementations, independently derived dq circuits and sampled controller reconstruction.

assumptions.initialization: Solve the sampled-controller periodic equilibrium with original 50 Hz source and command. No wave-shape or parameter fitting.
assumptions.plant_integrator: Primary trapezoidal electrical circuit with forward-Euler PI/LPF and one-sample abc bridge delay. Independent sensitivity uses exact held-source propagation. Original R2020b Tustin/Backward-Euler event history is unresolved.
assumptions.grid_event: Finite breaker resistance and two physical inductive branches retained. No reset of existing branch currents.
assumptions.internal_grid_inductance: The published Lc=1e-9 pu and Rc=1e-20 or Lc/5 are collapsed into the finite external grid branch. This is documented for the averaged circuit reconstruction.
assumptions.event_integrator_sensitivity: One backward-Euler step on each topology transition is a separately identified scenario. It does not claim exact source TBE implementation.
